name: meticulous-poll
description: Public audience polls for The Meticulous Investor

scripts.test: ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com node scripts/make-rules.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-meticulous-poll --only firestore "node --test test/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.dev: npm run build && ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com node scripts/make-rules.mjs && firebase emulators:start --project demo-meticulous-poll
scripts.deploy: npm run rules && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
